'''2024 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP, October–November 2024. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] won the Finals.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-10-online-championship-series-ocs-playoffs-oct-nov-2024/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' October–November 2024
